status: Provisional independent full-vessel journey scenarios; not observed ridership, verified vessel assignments or available island boarding capacity.
service_day_definition: GTFS service date selected at the Roosevelt Island stop. No selected island stop departures are after midnight.
metric: Passenger places for a specified journey, assuming every scheduled vessel runs and all its places are dedicated to that journey.

capacity_assumptions.interpretation: NYC Ferry describes vessels of these two capacities, but allocation to these trips is unknown. These are separate sensitivity scenarios, not confirmed lower and upper bounds.

East 34th St via Long Island City

limitations: Manhattan journeys remain on the same boat but call at a Queens landing en route; there is no directly adjacent Manhattan-to-island ferry segment in this schedule.

Queens and Manhattan journey options share the same 39 vessels at the island; their passenger-place totals are alternatives, not additive. A passenger may disembark in Queens and another board, but capacity available to island passengers depends on actual loads and stop turnover.
The figures for each journey assume all vessel places are devoted to that journey. They are theoretical gross offers, not actual ridership, verified available places or guaranteed operating capacity.
The vessel capacities used in the two scenarios are not confirmed assignments or actual minimum and maximum capacities on this service date.
Counts are planned GTFS trips, not proven operated trips. Rider flows, vessels and weekday service disruptions remain unverified.
East 34th Street is one Manhattan landing served southbound; the same southbound boats also reach Wall St/Pier 11 via Brooklyn Navy Yard. These are not additional sailings.
Ferry service-day totals should not be assumed comparable to calendar-day figures without checking time definitions.
